verdict.rationale: Temporal workflows and activities are literally written as real code (TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Go, Java) with Workflows-as-Code being a core design principle, and Activities are standalone functions that can run arbitrary code as a step — docs explicitly say 'Temporal isn't a no-code Workflow engine — it is Workflows-as-Code' and reference TypeScript/Python SDK development guides. missing for 10: no explicit code snippet in evidence showing an inline JS/Python function step, and no independent hands-on confirmation of writing custom code inside a workflow step beyond SDK doc mentions.
